acceptedPreviousChange.title: perf: reuse relative-path helper when saving redirects

baseline.scope: Tracked working tree after b260204, including inherited src/downloader/multi.ts cleanup. Unrelated src/shared-context.ts excluded from builds.

changes: Reuse a completed Promise for synchronous status notifications and track only pending notifications; retain ordered asynchronous listeners and disposal waiting.
Split query parameters at the first equals sign, reuse the parts array for ordered output, and encode SHA-256 directly as base64url.
retained.api: notifyStatusChange still returns Promise<void>. Query ordering, duplicate-value order, escaping and filename hashes remain byte-compatible.

rejected.decision: Do not retain the empty-metadata clone shortcut. Empty-message allocation savings varied across profiles and identical controls; the added metadata test also runs for populated messages. No whole-worker speedup was established.

environment.dependencies: Existing physical project packages; no new dependencies, Cheerio replacement, URIjs replacement or CSS parser.
environment.execution: Builds, tests, timing and profiling were serial. No GitHub API polling, CI triggering or remote push.

allocation.metric: Sampled cumulative allocation: inspector sampling interval 4096 bytes, including objects collected by major and minor GC. Three rotated baseline/candidate/identical-candidate triplets per mode; descriptive medians, not exact bytes or confidence intervals.
allocation.scope: Status fixtures isolate depth-limit rejection of prebuilt resources, including crawler initialization and disposal; two listeners per notification. Query fixtures create real resources through the link pipeline with deduplicateStripSearch=false. Engine profiles use four batches; timing uses two. Each MDN observation is one full replay of three saved HTML pages and one extracted stylesheet.
allocation.pressure: Real JavaScript arrays retained up to 2 MiB. Totals include identical harness churn, without subtracting a pressure baseline.
allocation.interpretation: The exact combined candidate lowers allocation in the selected workloads. This does not establish lower peak heap, retained heap or RSS.

measure-final.sh.source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
source /mnt/e/tmp/wse-resume-perf-memory-20261004/final-pass/env.sh
task_root=/mnt/e/tmp/wse-resume-perf-memory-20261004/final-pass
export WSE_CANDIDATE=combined
export WSE_ENGINE_CASES=status-sync,status-async,query-short,query-long
python3 "$task_root/freeze.py"
for mode in profile timing; do
  for suite in engine mdn; do
    for kind in normal pressure; do
      node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=128 --max-semi-space-size=4 \
        "$task_root/harness/compare-final.mjs" "$suite" "$kind" "$mode" \
        > "$task_root/logs/final-$suite-$kind-$mode.log" 2>&1
    done
  done
done
for kind in normal pressure; do
  for variant in 0 1 2; do
    for key in status-sync status-async query-long; do
      node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=128 --max-semi-space-size=4 \
        "$task_root/harness/retention.mjs" engine "$variant" "$kind" "$key" \
        > "$task_root/logs/retention-$key-$kind-$variant.json"
    done
    node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=128 --max-semi-space-size=4 \
      "$task_root/harness/retention.mjs" mdn "$variant" "$kind" mdn-local \
      > "$task_root/logs/retention-mdn-$kind-$variant.json"
  done
done
python3 "$task_root/verify.py" > "$task_root/logs/verification.json"

      > "$task_root/logs/profile-$candidate-$kind.log" 2>&1
  done
done

unset WSE_ENGINE_CASES
